caveat: Built from EU project documents and action plans, so the plans may well outrun what happened.
title: Building impactful and inclusive TVET ecosystems: a multiple-case study of challenges and co-designed actions in post-compulsory learning
why: Quadruple-helix ecosystem work in seven mid-sized European cities, which is the scale Zwolle actually operates at rather than the metropolitan scale most living-lab papers assume.
